music_atelier_theme.description: Calm, warm background music for a sunlit art museum restoration atelier in a cozy anime game. Soft felt piano melody, gentle string quartet pads, light harp arpeggios and a delicate music box counter-melody. Tender, slightly magical and nostalgic, relaxed tempo around 80 BPM, no drums, no harsh highs, comfortable to listen to for a long time while exploring and assembling statues.
